# Title preset render fixtures

These projects are generated by `title_cpu_goldens_and_safe_areas` from the bundled
preset data. Each title occupies seconds 5–10; the committed PNGs in `../golden`
show second 6 at 320x180 through the real WASM text/shapes components and CPU
renderer. Maximum permitted error is 2 per RGBA channel.

Intentional regeneration (review and commit both JSON and PNG changes):

```sh
UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=3 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only nice -n 19 ionice -c3 cargo test --workspace --locked title_cpu_goldens_and_safe_areas
```

The same test also renders every preset at 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 4K-derived
preview sizes and checks the resting safe area. Chapter-card backgrounds are
intentionally full frame. `edited_multiline_text_stays_in_its_safe_box` checks
that edits shrink to their assigned text box without reaching the role below.
